snippet.title: Nourish - Official Trailer | Indie Horror Game
snippet.description:
🥀 Care for a mysterious alien plant in this retro-style horror game. Manage resources, maintain your ship, and keep Project Váyu alive — or face the deadly consequences.

🎮 Wishlist's now available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3703030/Nourish
